meta.source: Shobdokosh original literary and reading glossary
meta.license: Original editorial English wording; linked references retain their rights
meta.description: Selected vocabulary for reading Bengali literature, including poetry, fiction and older prose. Each concise explanation is original English wording checked against a linked lexical reference. This targeted supplement is not an exhaustive concordance or a complete set of senses.
meta.editorialNotice: No dictionary example sentences, poems or passages are reproduced. Common lexical facts are expressed in original concise English. Spelling variants are included only when the reference identifies them; grammatical meanings include context notes.
